data.headline: Chief Strategist & Technology Officer, Wipro Ltd.
data.about:
Hari Shetty serves as Chief Strategist and Technology Officer at Wipro, bringing over three decades of experience to the role. He oversees the company’s strategy, technology, marketing, corporate development, analyst, advisor, partner relations, as well as sales excellence functions.

As Chief Strategist, Hari focuses on understanding macroeconomic shifts and technology trends that are reshaping industries. Wipro Intelligence is at the core of Wipro’s strategy, and Hari’s role overseeing the CTO organization gives him unique leverage to drive execution. Wipro’s Innovation Network (WIN) leads applied research in areas such as Agentic AI, Physical AI (Robotics), Quantum Computing, and Digital Ledger Technology, working in collaboration with leading universities like MIT and IISc. 

Turning strategy into results requires strong execution across marketing, sales excellence, and corporate development. The Sales Excellence function drives continuous improvement in deal origination, global sales processes, sales assets, learning and development, and performance metrics. Corporate Development complements this by leading mergers and acquisitions that expand Wipro’s capabilities in new markets and technologies.

Before stepping into his current role, Hari Shetty led Wipro’s technology sector with full P&L responsibility. Under his leadership, Wipro delivered a comprehensive portfolio of services—including silicon engineering, product design, live operations, and customer success—for some of the world’s most notable technology clients. He also played a key role in building other industry units, such as Retail & Distribution, where he incubated and scaled the business through strategic client partnerships, positioning Wipro as a top-tier service provider.

Before this role, Hari served as the “Change & Transform” leader within Wipro’s consumer business division, driving strategic initiatives in digital transformation, cloud services, engineering services, and cybersecurity. He has shared his expertise through articles and insights and has spoken at various forums on technological disruption and business value creation. In 2024, he was rated among the world’s Top 25 Technology Consultants and Leaders.

An alumnus of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Hari holds a multidisciplinary educational background with degrees in computer science & engineering, management, finance, and law. Additionally, he was part of the executive leadership program at the Harvard Business School on “Leading Professional Service Firms.”

description.text: Tasked with the critical responsibility of analyzing and interpreting the vast array of economic, industry and technology trends that are constantly reshaping the business landscape of our client organizations and creating opportunities for our services. Developing a forward-thinking strategy that prepares our company to not only adapt but also to thrive in any environment and position us at the forefront of the IT service industry. The combination of strategy with sales excellence provides the opportunity to blend strategic foresight with sales execution, ensuring that our strategies are not only thoughtfully conceived but also effectively implemented.
